description:
## Why

The "differential" part of PKIX-hbzo.1. Once both per-oracle adapters exist (.1.1 zlint + .1.2 pkilint), wire them together as a 3-way differential against pkix-lint-cabf + ship the corpus/baseline/CI artefacts.

## What

### 1. Reconciliation logic

New `pkix-difftest/src/lint_oracles/reconcile.rs`. Function:

```rust
pub fn classify_cert(
    pkix_findings: &[NormalizedFinding],
    zlint_findings: &[NormalizedFinding],
    pkilint_findings: &[NormalizedFinding],
) -> LintClassification
```

`LintClassification` = `{ Agreement, PkixStricter { ids: Vec<String> }, PkixLaxer { ids: Vec<String> }, OraclesDisagree { ... }, ToolError { ... } }`. Compare by finding ID after a normalization step (lowercasing, stripping vendor prefixes — TBD when concrete IDs collide).

### 2. CA/B Forum test corpus

Source candidates (in priority order):
- zlint testdata at `~/GIT/zlint/v3/lints/cabf_br/*/testdata/` (Apache-2.0, citable) — already on disk per AGENTS.md SoT-for-other-projects rule.
- pkilint test fixtures.
- Hand-curated marquee certs from x509-limbo CA/B Forum slices.

Decision: at minimum mirror a small slice of zlint testdata under `pkix-difftest/fixtures/cabf-lint/`, properly attributed. Number TBD; aim for ~20–50 certs covering SC-081 validity, SHA-1 prohibition, RSA key size, SAN/EKU presence.

### 3. Baseline output

`pkix-difftest/baseline-cabf-lint.json` (machine-readable) + `baseline-cabf-lint.md` (human-readable). JSON shape mirrors the existing `baseline-pkits.json` / `baseline-limbo.json` layout where possible.

### 4. CI integration

New `.github/workflows/cabf-lint-diff.yml`:
- Install zlint binary (Go build or vendored from upstream release).
- Install pkilint (`pip install pkilint` in a venv).
- Run `cargo run --features lint-oracles --bin difftest -- cabf-lint --baseline baseline-cabf-lint.json`.
- Diff `.summary` and `.classified[].classification` only (skip reason strings — same false-positive-suppression discipline as `ci-diff-baseline.sh` per PKIX-klku memory).

### 5. Analysis MD

`pkix-difftest/baseline-cabf-lint-analysis.md` — written like `baseline-pkits-analysis.md` / `baseline-limbo-analysis.md`. Sections: setup, agreement count, where pkix-lint-cabf is stricter (probably none — small curated set), where it is laxer (most of zlint catalog, intentionally), where zlint and pkilint disagree (the actually interesting cases).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `LintClassification` enum + `classify_cert` in `lint_oracles/reconcile.rs`.
- [ ] CA/B Forum fixture corpus under `pkix-difftest/fixtures/cabf-lint/` with attribution.
- [ ] Baseline JSON + MD generation invocable via `cargo run --features lint-oracles --bin difftest -- cabf-lint`.
- [ ] `baseline-cabf-lint.{json,md}` files committed under `pkix-difftest/`.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/cabf-lint-diff.yml` runs on every push.
- [ ] Workflow installs zlint (Go) and pkilint (Python venv) deterministically.
- [ ] Diff scope is `.summary` + `.classified[].classification` only (no reason strings).
- [ ] `pkix-difftest/baseline-cabf-lint-analysis.md` documents intentional vs unintentional divergence.

## Out of scope

- pyca venv caching (mirror PKIX-klku decision: out of scope here too).
- Multi-platform CI (Linux only; same rationale as PKIX-klku).
- Treating divergence as test failure (per parent PKIX-hbzo.1 body: "Treat divergence increases as warnings, not failures").

## Depends on

- `.1.1` (zlint adapter shipped).
- `.1.2` (pkilint adapter shipped — itself blocked on PKIX-jy95.8).

## Filed by

Decomposition of PKIX-hbzo.1 (2026-05-12). The reconciliation/corpus/baseline/CI/analysis chunk is naturally one unit — they all depend on having both oracles wired.
title: pkix-difftest: 3-way lint differential (reconciliation + corpus + baseline + CI + analysis)
